queries: first 25 calibration queries in original order
seed_policy: first 16 identity document blocks; distinct actual documents; kth seed score or zero when insufficient
bounds: exact uint8 per-term per-block maxima, uint64 weighted sum
skip_rule: skip only bounds strictly below seed threshold; retain equal bounds
schedule: stable three-pass prefix compaction; seed blocks already scored and excluded from rescore
scorer: same block_scores CSR scorer and hierarchical GPU merger as parent
skipped_score_policy: zero the entire dense score buffer before every pruned query; skipped positive losers may have zero placeholder scores and must not be described as full-score matches

correctness.fixtures: regular sizes 0/1/17/255/256/257/1025/8193; depths 0/1/10/100/128; five independent queries; modes 0 and 1 at both block sizes
correctness.special_fixture: prunable 1025 documents, k10: positive certified losers plus a tied winner in the final partial block with the smallest original ID
correctness.real_data: 100K/1M, 25 calibration queries, k10; modes 0 and 1 at B16/B32
checks: every upper bound against CPU term-max sum and full-reference block maximum
threshold against actual distinct seed witnesses
every skipped document strictly below threshold and zeroed placeholder
wrong expected tie-pruning mark must be rejected before query compute

timing.cpu_affinity: minimum allowed logical CPU, resolved and frozen on CIMS
timing.primary_statistic: geometric mean of query-wise pruned/control median query wall ratios
timing.uncertainty: 10000 query-pair percentile bootstrap samples, seed 20261111, conditional 95% interval
timing.boundary: weight preparation/upload, score reset, seed scoring/selection, bounds, stable compaction, survivor-count transfer, survivor scoring, global merging and winner copy
timing.excluded: index/plane build/upload, runtime gate, CPU oracle, validation-only and diagnostic threshold transfers, file I/O and monitoring
timing.cache: repeated resident calibration workload; both paths in one process with pruning metadata resident
timing.monitoring: GPU clocks/power/memory/compute PIDs sampled; shared-node contention limits interpretation
timing.stopping: fixed rounds; no optional stopping/tuning; stop on any correctness failure; defer timing if selected GPU remains occupied for ten minutes

decision_rule: A ratio below 1 with interval below 1 is promising within this calibration execution. Above 1 is negative. An interval crossing 1 is inconclusive. No held-out/general service inference.
declared_changes: Add full-byte term-major block maxima plane, prefix seed policy, strict-bound filter, stable compaction and score-reset policy.
Add mode 0 matched unpruned, mode 1 pruned validation, mode 2 paired resident measurement.
Factor parent main behind a preprocessor guard; default parent executable is unchanged.
Add new runtime config/semantic fields and explicit not_checked for disabled in-process validation.
Pruned dense score placeholders are not actual document scores; verify only evaluated scores and independently certify skipped losers.
limitations: No held-out access; no selective refinement yet; k>128 unsupported.
Full-byte maxima add substantial resident metadata; no peak-memory reduction is assumed.
Paired process holds metadata for both rows, so control peak memory cannot be inferred from paired allocation counts.
Correctness code and CUDA compilation still need CIMS execution; no new results exist yet.
